story.title: Parse config booleans
story.goal: Turn config strings into real booleans.
story.catch: It is not just true/false — real configs say yes, 1, on, Y, FALSE. A first attempt handles the obvious two and silently returns False for the rest.
story.steering: Accept yes/no, 1/0, on/off, case-insensitive — and raise on anything unrecognised.
story.why_it_matters: Silently returning False for "yes" is how a feature flag stays off in production while the config file says it is on. The failure is invisible until someone asks why the rollout did nothing.
